doc_verification.detail: Contract users+create documents password 6<=len<=72 (live-confirmed len 5 -> 1100)。文档未记载密码内容字符约束（NUL/控制字符）——这正是 gap：长度校验存在、内容无校验。

secondary_observations: auth with full pwd -> HTTP 400 400 Bad Request
73 chars (max+1)                       -> code=1100  {"code":1100,"message":"invalid password length: invalid parameter[73 out of range 6 <= value <= 72]"}
empty string password                  -> code=1802 ...Field validation for 'Password' failed on the 'requir...'
6 unicode chars (18 bytes)             -> code=0 (长度按 UTF-8 字节计仍合规)

http_semantics.note: 创建含 NUL 密码 users/create 为 HTTP 200+code:0（本链主张的静默接受）；auth 端 full-pwd 400 来自 gin 头解析层面

triggering_scripts: live-recheck 2026-08-22 by builder (create w/ NUL: 200 code:0; truncated 'ab' auth: 200 code:0; full pwd auth: 400)

contract_grounding.constraint_id: users+create password rule (api_endpoints users+create: '6 <= len <= 72; live v2.6.17: len 5 -> 1100')
contract_grounding.assertion_text_quoted: password: 6 <= len <= 72; live v2.6.17: len 5 -> 1100 'invalid password length ... 5 out of range 6 <= value <= 72'
contract_grounding.note: violates=True 理由：语义上密码是完整 15 字节串（长度校验也按 15 字节通过），但实际生效凭证是 NUL 截断的 'ab'（2 字节 < min 6）——等同接受了长度 2 的密码；且用户提供完整密码反而 400，凭据与输入分裂。

chain_links: doc: 本地 clone 源码 URL 可达，PasswordReq 仅 binding:required
script: users/create {password: 'ab\x00cdxxxxxxxxxx'} -> code:0; Bearer user:ab -> 200 code:0; Bearer user:full -> 400
log: 逐字三行（create code:0 / truncated auth 200 / full auth 400）

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: users/create -> handler_v2 -> proxy CreateCredential -> ValidatePassword(仅 len) -> crypto.PasswordEncrypt(bcrypt, NUL 后内容丢失) -> etcd。认证: HTTP Basic/Bearer -> passwordVerify -> SHA256(rawPwd,username) 命中/未命中缓存 -> miss 时 bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword(NUL 截断比较)。全程无 NUL 检查。

excluded: env(本地 v2.6.17 容器两轮复现)
请求笔误(full/truncated 双向对照)
缓存延迟(200/400 方向确定)

evidence_weight.A_contract: 长度规则显式；内容字符约束为契约空白(gap 即缺陷空间)
evidence_weight.B_log: 主观测三行逐字 + builder 独立复跑一次，方向一致
evidence_weight.C_control: 无 NUL 密码 72/73/empty/missing 对照齐全(1100/1802 正确拒绝)
evidence_weight.D_source: ValidatePassword 仅长度 + bcrypt NUL 截断比较点定位(util.go:1516)
evidence_weight.overall: A 级：契约-gap-源码-行为四面对齐，可独立复现
